title: NobleCraft
description: Welcome to NobleCraft!We have a friendly building incentive system to support your grand builds, plus fun survival gameplay for an enjoyable experience.
body:
Server Features:

> Requires Minecraft international official version 1.21.4. No whitelist. IP address obtained within the group.

> Friendly building incentive system to help you build your grand vision.

> Server features fun survival add-ons, skill attribute growth, and a quest system.

> Immersive main city world experience. Enjoy the world view, character storylines, and participate in them.

> Efficient shortcut menus. Almost completely eliminates the need for command input.

> Server uses a physical currency economy. Open shops and stalls in the free trade zone and trade with other players.

> Harmonious and loving player community. Help each other and jointly plan community building.

> Comprehensive survival world transportation with diverse options, connecting various player settlements.

> Focus on individual player needs. Administrators are easy to talk to; even command assistance can be requested.

> Allow more permissions to help players develop their hobbies, such as redstone music/personal building.

> Continuous fun, such as video recording/video events.

> Based on adherence to multiplayer game etiquette rules and server performance. Respect for individual player development is paramount.

(In short, you're welcome to join us!)
